method: Count all actual LLVM disassembly instruction rows, byte widths and SP-based memory operands, after independent full native instruction coverage checks. Counts include saves, restores and reply stores; they are not all removable spills.
scope: Static source-bound Windows compiler observations; no runtime frequency or feature-completion claim. Build logs are retained locally rather than published. A metadata-only checker does not advertise actual archived-log replay.
